full_name: Christopher S. Kochanek | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2018–2019 Physical Sciences William Bentinck-Smith Fellow The Ohio State University
bio: Christopher S. Kochanek is an Ohio Eminent Scholar and professor of astronomy at the Ohio State University. His current research focuses on “massive stars behaving badly”: searching for exploding massive stars, stars destroyed by supermassive black holes and other luminous transients, and stars that die to form black holes without luminous explosions.
